actual: Two post-restart MA-E05 exact-snapshot retries successfully passed CAS path admission, created durable attempts, and reserved real QE Workspace tasks on wsl2-5080, proving BUG-963/BUG-967 effective. Both remote tasks then failed immediately with return code 127 because _remote_wsl_command invoked python without activating the configured WSL conda runtime: run.log says 'bash: python: command not found'. The loopback WSL deployment already declares QLIB_WSL_CONDA_SH and QLIB_WSL_CONDA_ENV in the canonical backend environment, while the frozen run config contains only node_id. Expected: loopback local-WSL durable dispatch consumes the explicit deployed WSL conda settings, validates them, and activates that environment before any Python command; genuine remote Linux behavior remains unchanged and missing local-WSL runtime configuration fails closed. No backend process control or database change.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
